name: Liebender
source:
A Gothic romance adventure that can be played from both female sacrifice Marie and male vampire perspectives. Is there any other outcome than sacrifice be killed by vampire? Who is Marie's loved one Heinrich's loved one?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-october-2007-boku-ga-sadame.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
这是一部哥特式浪漫冒险作品，玩家既可以从女性祭品玛丽的视角游玩，也可以从男性吸血鬼的视角游玩。除了祭品被吸血鬼杀害之外，是否还存在其他结局？玛丽所爱之人海因里希，又爱着谁？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-october-2007-boku-ga-sadame.html]vndbreview[/url]]
